recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片而非切片：雙側小腿可見不規則、網狀邊緣的紫黑色壞死斑塊（retiform purpura），中央有黑色焦痂與潰瘍、黃色腐肉，周邊有紅紫色邊緣；這種網狀紫斑合併壞死提示皮膚小血管血栓，需考慮 PNH 等血栓性疾病。
features: Large, irregular retiform (branching, angulated-edge) purpuric plaques on both lower legs
Central dusky violaceous to black necrosis with eschar formation
Ulceration with yellow fibrinous slough and exposed pink granulation tissue in the right leg lesion
Violaceous to erythematous hemorrhagic borders with superficial desquamation
Multiple separate lesions (upper left and lower left fields), indicating a multifocal process
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the posterior lower legs shows multiple large, irregular retiform purpuric plaques with angulated, branching borders. The lesions have central violaceous-black necrosis with eschar and an area of ulceration covered by yellow fibrinous slough, surrounded by a dusky erythematous hemorrhagic rim. No histology is shown in this image, so dermal vessel thrombosis itself is not directly visualized; the title refers to the biopsy findings. The clinical pattern of retiform purpura with necrosis indicates occlusive cutaneous microvascular thrombosis and, in the context of a large GPI-deficient granulocyte clone, is consistent with thrombotic complications of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Produces identical retiform purpura with dermal thrombi; lupus anticoagulant and anticardiolipin/anti-beta2-glycoprotein I antibodies rather than a FLAER-negative clone establish the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Warfarin-induced skin necrosis or purpura fulminans (protein C/S deficiency)
ddx.vs: Temporal relation to warfarin initiation or sepsis with DIC and low protein C/S activity distinguish it; skin biopsy shows similar thrombi.
Occurs in end-stage renal disease and biopsy shows medial calcification of small subcutaneous arterioles rather than bland dermal thrombi alone.
Biopsy shows fibrinoid necrosis of vessel walls with neutrophilic infiltration and nuclear dust rather than intraluminal thrombi without vasculitis.
